description: List the listing automation's queue on a one-item-per-listing marketplace (Vinted): listings waiting to go up (after a sale, after a restock, on schedule, or a refresh), with the product, when each is due and its state (pending, waiting_stock, waiting_delete, running) — or, with scope history, what was done, skipped, cancelled or failed and why. Paginated with a real total. Read-only. Use cancel_listing_jobs to cancel waiting ones and get_listing_automation for the settings.

platform.description: The marketplace whose queue to read. Only vinted has listing automation today.

scope.description: open: listings still waiting (soonest first). history: what the automation did or skipped, newest first, with the reason.

name: list_listing_jobs
title: List listing automation queue
